title: download_blob/upload_blob buffer entire body before size-cap check
description: Both download_blob and upload_blob call resp.bytes().await (which buffers the full body into one Bytes allocation) before comparing against the configured size cap. With Content-Length absent or lying, a server sending 200 MiB will cause a 200 MiB allocation before the 64 MiB cap is enforced. The Content-Length early-exit is an optimization only. Streaming read with a manual byte cap would prevent OOM. This is a real OOM window at the library's documented limit boundary.
